title: Indonesian fortune: VOC bills of exchange between Asia and the Dutch Republic, 1690-1720
contributors: F.S. Gaastra, Department of History, Leiden University (research initiator)
descriptions: The dataset contains an inventory of the bills of exchange to the East of the Dutch East Indian Company (VOC) during the period 1690-1720. It includes the following data: names and occupations of the clients, brokers, benificiaries, types of currencies and information on the salaries of the VOC employees.
